question: Which country will host the Men's Cricket World Cup in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India **will be hosting the **Men's Cricket World Cup **for the **first time since 2011**.
 
• The tournament is scheduled to take place between February and March 2023.
